title.english: Umm Hashim: She will appear under Umm Hisham. Ibn Abd al-Barr said: “Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasaf narrated from her.” Ibn Fathun objected to this on the grounds that Khubayb narrated from her only through an intermediary; it is as he said.

segments.arabic:
١٢٢٨٨- أم هاشم «١»
: تأتي في أم هشام. قال ابن عبد البر: روى عنها خبيب بن عبد الرّحمن بن يساف. وتعقبه ابن فتحون بأن خيبا إنما روى عنها بواسطة، وهو كما قال.
segments.english: 12288—Umm Hashim: She will appear under Umm Hisham. Ibn Abd al-Barr said: “Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasaf narrated from her.” Ibn Fathun objected to this on the grounds that Khubayb narrated from her only through an intermediary; it is as he said.

names.arabic: خبيب بن عبد الرحمن بن يساف
names.english: Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasaf
